player.speaker: Front Commissar
line.reaction-briliant.speaker: Mária Tóth
line.reaction-briliant.text: Miskolc fell faster than the Czechoslovak staff believed possible. Their northern grouping is separating from its supply.
line.reaction-tactical.speaker: Mária Tóth
line.reaction-tactical.text: Miskolc cost us more than the map suggests. The corps needs replacements before it is asked to exploit anything.
line.reaction-victory.speaker: Mária Tóth
line.reaction-victory.text: Miskolc is ours. The advance can continue, though the mobile formations have already outrun their columns.
line.callback-complex-saved.speaker: Jenő Landler
line.callback-complex-saved.text: Ozd and Kazincbarcika came through undamaged. The furnaces are lit, the rolling mills are turning, and the railway repair shops are ours.
line.callback-complex-lost.speaker: Jenő Landler
line.callback-complex-lost.text: We took Miskolc and lost the works at Ozd and Kazincbarcika doing it. What we need now cannot be manufactured behind this front.
line.callback-miskolc.speaker: Jenő Landler
line.callback-miskolc.text: Miskolc is secure and the northern road is open.
line.callback-turning-vindicated.speaker: Gyula Hevesi
line.callback-turning-vindicated.text: Your turning movement forced the evacuation and saved the works. I warned that the flank could stall. It did not. Show me a road that clear again and I will hear your plan before I object to it.
line.callback-turning-cost.speaker: Gyula Hevesi
line.callback-turning-cost.text: The mobile columns found their open road. Ozd and Kazincbarcika paid for the exposed industrial flank. Do not tell the workers that losing their mills was the price of momentum; they know whose plan placed the price on their towns.
line.callback-concentric-vindicated.text: I wanted the simultaneous assault. You also gave Stromfeld time to bind it to one timetable. The stations fell together and the works survived. Next time I demand speed, remind me what that hour of staff work saved.
line.callback-concentric-cost.speaker: Aurél Stromfeld
line.callback-concentric-cost.role: Chief of Staff, Hungarian Red Army
line.callback-concentric-cost.text: I wrote an hour beside every attack and still watched them separate. The works burned while each column waited for the others. Keep my timetable, Commissar. I want it read aloud before I call the next plan careful.
line.kassa-rail-report.speaker: Mária Tóth
line.kassa-rail-report.text: My old crew is still inside Kassa. They smuggled out this timetable with three grease marks for trains the garrison has not filled yet. Give them our signal, and they will lock those engines in the sheds.
line.landler-opening.speaker: Jenő Landler
line.landler-opening.text: A month ago these formations retreated without staffs. Now they quarrel over the lead. Kassa is the hinge between the enemy fronts. Take its junction and the road north opens; fail there and our recovery ends in Miskolc.
line.stromfeld-question.speaker: Aurél Stromfeld
line.stromfeld-question.role: Chief of Staff, Hungarian Red Army
line.stromfeld-question.text: The line is shaken, but our spearheads have already outrun repaired track. Do we pursue before Kassa can organise, accepting thin supply, or pause just long enough to bring artillery and railway crews forward for a battle we can sustain after the first day?
line.stromfeld-question.choice.rapid-pur: Advance at once. Deny the enemy time to organise Kassa and seize the junction before reinforcements arrive.
Gain a larger prestige award and experience for every core formation, but forgo the armoured train and full resupply.
line.stromfeld-question.choice.prepared-: Bring up artillery, repair the railway, and strike with the divisions supplied for a sustained battle.
Gain an armoured train and fully resupply every core formation, but forgo the rapid pursuit's prestige and core-wide experience.
line.landler-pursuit.speaker: Jenő Landler
line.landler-pursuit.text: Momentum is a weapon. Keep the spearhead narrow, leave security detachments at the stations, and do not let scattered resistance halt the main column.
line.stromfeld-prepared.speaker: Aurél Stromfeld
line.stromfeld-prepared.role: Chief of Staff, Hungarian Red Army
line.stromfeld-prepared.text: A prepared attack reduces losses, but the pause must be measured in hours, not days. The enemy must not receive the time we are using to move our guns.
line.railway-delegate.speaker: Mária Tóth
line.railway-delegate.text: Workers inside Kassa say the switches and engine sheds are intact. Put engineers at the head of the column, seize the signal boxes before demolition teams reach them, and the railway can feed the advance instead of marking the route of our retreat.
line.stromfeld-final.speaker: Aurél Stromfeld
line.stromfeld-final.role: Chief of Staff, Hungarian Red Army
line.stromfeld-final.text: Reach Kassa before those empty trains fill. Keep its signal boxes intact and the railway crews ahead of the demolition parties. The next advance begins with whichever locomotive still moves.
